binding.response: let username: string = request.path.username; let followers = component:golem-x-interface/user-api.{get-followers}(); let followings = component:golem-x-interface/user-api.{get-followings}(); let response = {status: 200u8, user: {username: username, followers: followers, followings: followings}}; {status: 200u8, body: response}

let target_user: string = request.body.user; let followed: bool = component:golem-x-interface/user-api.{follow}(target_user); let status: u16 = if followed then 201 else 400; let response = {status: status, followed: followed}; {status: status, body: response}

let target_user: string = request.body.user; let unfollowed: bool = component:golem-x-interface/user-api.{unfollow}(target_user); let status: u16 = if unfollowed then 200 else 400; let response = {status: status, unfollowed: unfollowed}; {status: status, body: response}
let content: string = request.body.content; let tweet = component:golem-x-interface/tweet-api.{post-tweet}(content); let response = {status: 201u8, tweet: tweet}; {status: 201u8, body: response}

let tweets_limit: option<u8> = request.path.limit; let limit: u8 = match tweets_limit { some(lim) => lim, none => 10 } ; let tweets = component:golem-x-interface/tweet-api.{get-tweets}(limit); let response = {status: 200u8, tweets: tweets}; {status: 200u8, body: response}
let tweets = component:golem-x-interface/timeline-api.{get-timeline}(); let response = {status: 200u8, tweets: tweets}; {status: 200u8, body: response}
